notice: Generated by `go test ./internal/cdreason/ -run TestCDReadyReasonTableIsCurrent` in go/core-provider, with UPDATE_READY_REASONS=1 to rewrite it, from the same registry as docs/cd-ready-reasons.md: one entry per row of that table, in its order. Do not edit by hand. A reason is identified by condition, reason, status and writer. RENAMING OR REMOVING A REASON, OR CHANGING ITS STATUS, IS BREAKING FOR CONSUMERS: a reason a release carried leaves the registry only through its deprecated list, printed below with the release it was removed in, and a test refuses any other removal. The set is CLOSED. verdict is how a parent composition's rollup reads a CompositionDefinition child carrying the reason, on Ready only ("—" elsewhere). clearance.kind is steady, next pass or indefinite; the markdown has no column for it. sinceVersion is the first core-provider release whose source (with its pinned runtime) contains the reason, a lower bound for a reason string another condition used first; "unreleased" until a release ships it. action is what a person does, shown on screen: changing it is a UI change. detailFields are the status fields carrying the reason's detail beyond the condition's own message. Refuse a schemaVersion you do not know.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: Observe: the CRD serves the version and is Established, and the controller Deployment has rolled out and is available for its current generation (Diego, 2026-11-16); on a follower, the shared controller, and the message names the definition that owns it

clearance.detail: idle until the first instance, which wakes the controller

reasons.meaning: Observe: the controller is at 0 replicas and the definition opted into scale-to-zero (#393); it wakes on the first instance

clearance.detail: until the CRD is Established and the controller Deployment has rolled out; no deadline of its own

reasons.meaning: Observe: a first pass (seeded before any work), the CRD does not exist yet or is not yet Established, the controller Deployment is absent or rolling out, an update pending with no earlier verdict to keep (#395), or the definition has just become the controller's owner (#387); for a pool member whose pool runs, its controller is starting there, its ownership Lease not yet held by the pool for less than G (20s at the default timings), or is taking over from the Lease's current holder (#653). Update: the pass that switches status to a new version, until Observe looks at its controller
reasons.action: Wait: it clears when the CRD is established and the controller has rolled out.

clearance.detail: until the cause the message names is fixed

reasons.meaning: Observe: the chart cannot be read, the controller has 0 replicas without opting into scale-to-zero, the controller Deployment gave up its rollout (ProgressDeadlineExceeded) or lost availability after a completed one, a pool member's controller is not running in its pool (its ownership Lease not held by the pool for G or more, #653), or adding the served version is refused (a held version, no room); the message says which, and for lost availability ends with the first not-ready pod's cause, e.g. "; pod <name>: restarting (last exit: Error)" (#559)
reasons.action: Fix what the message names: the chart, the controller's replicas or rollout, or the served version that cannot be added.

clearance.detail: until the chart's URL is one the remote target can fetch

reasons.meaning: remote seed: the chart's URL is cluster-local to the management cluster, so the remote target cannot fetch it
reasons.action: Point the definition at a chart URL the remote cluster can reach.

clearance.detail: until the chart's values.schema.json is fixed

reasons.meaning: Observe: a `default` in the chart's values.schema.json that crdgen carries into the CRD fails its own subschema, so no CRD is generated; the message names each JSON pointer (plumbing#205). Nothing is applied, and a definition that worked before keeps serving its last CRD
reasons.action: Fix each default the message names in the chart's values.schema.json, then use that chart version.

clearance.detail: until the chart ships a root values.schema.json, or the definition opts into an inferred schema

reasons.meaning: Observe: the chart has no values.schema.json at its root, so no typed CRD can be generated and nothing is applied; the message names the chart (#566)
reasons.action: Add a values.schema.json at the chart's root, or opt the definition into an inferred schema with the krateo.io/values-schema: infer annotation.

clearance.detail: until the chart's name and Chart.yaml version yield names that fit

reasons.meaning: Observe: a name derived from the chart's name and Chart.yaml version does not fit Kubernetes' limits: the CRD version is not a DNS-1035 label, the controller Deployment's name (also its selector label) is over 63 characters, or, with cdc.metrics.enabled, the controller Service's is; the message names each name, its length and the problem. Nothing is applied, and a definition that worked before keeps what it has (#588)
reasons.action: Shorten the chart's name or its Chart.yaml version: the message names each name that does not fit.

clearance.detail: until the deletion completes

reasons.meaning: Delete: the definition is being deleted
reasons.action: Wait: it clears when the deletion completes.

clearance.detail: the next pass, after the retry backoff; persists while the error does

reasons.meaning: Connect or Observe returned an error not marked ReadyAssessed (for example, the controller Deployment could not be read); the error is on Synced
reasons.action: Wait: it is retried. If it lasts, the error is on Synced.

clearance.detail: the next Observe reports the outcome; the error, if any, is on Synced

reasons.meaning: the create path: written with every Create outcome, success or failure (the error, if any, is on Synced)
reasons.action: Wait: it clears on the next pass. If it lasts, the error is on Synced.

clearance.detail: until the deletion completes

reasons.meaning: the delete path, and an Observe error on a definition being deleted
reasons.action: Wait: it clears when the deletion completes.

clearance.detail: until a human changes krateo.io/management-policy to allow create

reasons.meaning: the external resource (the CRD) is absent and krateo.io/management-policy withholds create, observe-only included; nothing is created until a human changes the policy (#110 D4)
reasons.action: To create it, change the krateo.io/management-policy annotation to allow create.

clearance.detail: until krateo.io/management-policy allows update

reasons.meaning: core-provider's Observe found drift and krateo.io/management-policy withholds update: replaces a healthy Ready only, so the definition works but is NOT brought to its desired state; an unhealthy Ready keeps its own reason, with "updates are withheld by policy" appended (#110 D4)
reasons.action: To apply changes, change the krateo.io/management-policy annotation to allow update.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: the pass completed

clearance.detail: retried with backoff; persists while the cause does

reasons.meaning: the pass failed (message: the error); with Ready=False/SchemaDefaultContradiction it reads "observe failed: " followed by Ready's message
reasons.action: Wait: the pass is retried. If it lasts, fix the error the message names.

clearance.detail: until krateo.io/paused is removed

reasons.meaning: krateo.io/paused is set; Ready is left as it was
reasons.action: To resume, remove the krateo.io/paused annotation.

clearance.detail: until a human fixes krateo.io/management-policy

reasons.meaning: krateo.io/management-policy does not parse: the reconciler acts on nothing (observe only); wins over the pass's own Synced outcome; paused and deferred passes keep theirs
reasons.action: Fix the krateo.io/management-policy annotation: the message names the value it cannot read.

clearance.detail: until a human fixes krateo.io/deletion-policy

reasons.meaning: krateo.io/deletion-policy is neither delete nor orphan, so the external resource is KEPT on delete; reported on every pass while set
reasons.action: Set the krateo.io/deletion-policy annotation to delete or orphan.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: the controller Deployment has replicas declared; the message says whether scale-to-zero applies and when; for a pool member, its pool runs, and its controller holds its ownership Lease, is starting or is taking over (#653)

clearance.detail: idle until the first instance, which wakes the controller

reasons.meaning: 0 replicas, and the definition opted into scale-to-zero: idle, wakes on the first instance (#393)

clearance.detail: until the controller has replicas, the definition opts into scale-to-zero, or the pool holds the member's Lease

reasons.meaning: 0 replicas, and the definition did NOT opt into scale-to-zero, or, for a pool member, its ownership Lease has not been held by the pool for G or more (#653): nothing reconciles the Kind
reasons.action: Give the controller replicas, or opt the definition into scale-to-zero; for a pool member, an admin checks its pool.

clearance.detail: the next Observe that can read the controller Deployment (or list the pool's Leases)

reasons.meaning: the controller Deployment was not found or could not be read, or, for a pool member, core-provider has not listed the ownership Leases yet (#653)
reasons.action: Wait: it is retried. If it lasts, an admin checks that the controller Deployment exists.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: the generated CRD enforces every constraint in the chart's values schema

clearance.detail: until the chart's schema or crdgen changes; recomputed on every Observe

reasons.meaning: crdgen could not express some constraints, so the cluster accepts values the schema rejects; the message names them (recomputed on every Observe)
reasons.action: Review the constraints the message names: the cluster does not enforce them, so values that break them are accepted.

clearance.detail: while another definition generates the CRD

reasons.meaning: a follower: another definition generates the CRD; the message names it
reasons.action: Read this on the definition the message names: it generates the CRD.

clearance.detail: while the spec schema is inferred (ValuesSchemaAuthored=False)

reasons.meaning: the spec schema was inferred (ValuesSchemaAuthored=False): it has no authored constraints, so True, which means authored constraints all enforced, cannot be claimed (#568 D6)
reasons.action: To have constraints enforced, ship a values.schema.json at the chart's root.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: the served and generated spec schemas are identical

clearance.detail: the next Update writes the generated schema

reasons.meaning: transient: the generated schema is provably looser and the next Update writes it
reasons.action: Wait: the next update writes the new schema.

clearance.detail: until the chart version changes

reasons.meaning: until the chart version changes: the generated schema differs in a way not provably looser, so the served one is kept rather than risk refusing stored values
reasons.action: Publish the schema change under a new chart version: the served schema is kept until the version changes.

clearance.detail: while another definition generates the CRD

reasons.meaning: a follower: another definition generates the CRD
reasons.action: Read this on the definition the message names: it generates the CRD.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: the apiRef's RESTAction read-set was resolved and its RBAC rendered

clearance.detail: until the RESTAction exists; retried on every pass

reasons.meaning: snowplow says the RESTAction does not exist
reasons.action: Create the RESTAction the apiRef names, or fix the apiRef.

clearance.detail: until the caller may read the RESTAction (it may also not exist); retried on every pass

reasons.meaning: the caller may not read the RESTAction; it MAY ALSO NOT EXIST, so this never means missing
reasons.action: An admin grants read access to the RESTAction, and checks that it exists.

clearance.detail: until the RESTAction changes; retried on every pass

reasons.meaning: a stage cannot be enumerated without dispatching it
reasons.action: Change the RESTAction stage the message names so it can be resolved without running it.

clearance.detail: until the request snowplow refused is fixed; retried on every pass

reasons.meaning: snowplow refused the request itself, such as extras naming a reserved key
reasons.action: Fix the apiRef: the message says what snowplow refused.

clearance.detail: until a usable identity reaches snowplow; retried on every pass

reasons.meaning: no usable identity reached snowplow
reasons.action: An admin checks the identity core-provider uses to call snowplow.

clearance.detail: retried on every pass; persists while snowplow cannot be reached

reasons.meaning: snowplow could not be reached, or ran out of time
reasons.action: Wait: it is retried. If it lasts, an admin checks that snowplow is running.

clearance.detail: until snowplow, or what is in front of it, answers as expected; retried on every pass

reasons.meaning: snowplow, or something in front of it, answered in a way nothing here recognises (including cyclic stages)
reasons.action: An admin checks snowplow and anything in front of it: the message names the answer.

clearance.detail: until core-provider has a snowplow URL, or the apiRef is removed

reasons.meaning: core-provider has no snowplow URL (apiRef RBAC is off in the chart) while the definition declares an apiRef
reasons.action: An admin turns on apiRef RBAC in core-provider's chart, or the definition's apiRef is removed.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: the authn mapping CRD serves spec.delegation and it is rendered onto the mapping

clearance.detail: until authn-crds 0.37.0 or later is installed

reasons.meaning: the installed authn mapping CRD does not serve spec.delegation (authn-crds < 0.37.0), so it is not rendered rather than pruned
reasons.action: An admin upgrades authn's CRDs to 0.37.0 or later.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: read live on this pass, both authorize: the controller's mapping, where the controller runs, and core-provider's own, on the management cluster (#642)

clearance.detail: until authn is installed on that cluster; every pass looks again

reasons.meaning: the cluster the controller runs in, or the management cluster (for core-provider's own mapping, #642), serves no serviceaccounts.serviceaccount.authn.krateo.io, so the mapping that belongs there is not written; the message names the cluster and what waits on it, and every pass looks again
reasons.action: An admin installs authn on the cluster the message names.

clearance.detail: written again by the next pass that may write; stays only while a policy withholds update

reasons.meaning: read live on this pass: the cluster serves the mapping kind, and the controller's mapping or core-provider's own is absent or does not authorize its ServiceAccount; the message names which. Written again by the next pass that may write; it stays only while a policy withholds update (#642)
reasons.action: Wait: the next pass writes the mapping. If it stays, allow update in the krateo.io/management-policy annotation.

clearance.detail: the pass is retried

reasons.meaning: a mapping could not be read on this pass, so it is not known to be there or to be missing; the message names which and the error, which is on Synced too, and the pass is retried (#642)
reasons.action: Wait: it is retried. If it lasts, the message names the error.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: the chart ships values.schema.json at its root, and the CRD is generated from it

clearance.detail: while the chart ships no values.schema.json and the definition opts into inference

reasons.meaning: the chart ships no values.schema.json and the definition opted in (krateo.io/values-schema: infer): the schema is inferred from values.yaml, typed-open, with no authored constraints; the message gives the rules version and the untyped paths
reasons.action: To have an authored schema, ship a values.schema.json at the chart's root.

clearance.detail: while another definition generates the CRD

reasons.meaning: a follower: another definition generates the CRD; the message names it
reasons.action: Read this on the definition the message names: it generates the CRD.

clearance.detail: until the next migration

reasons.meaning: every instance on the served version passed a dry-run create through it after the last migration; nothing reopens this until the next migration

clearance.detail: until the named instances satisfy the served version's schema; rechecked on every Observe

reasons.meaning: some instances hold values the served version refuses (validation ratcheting let the migration through); the message names them and the fields, and a write that changes those fields will be refused until they satisfy the new schema; rechecked on every Observe until all pass
reasons.action: Edit the named compositions' values so they satisfy the new version's schema.

clearance.detail: rechecked on every Observe

reasons.meaning: no instance was refused, but some could not be judged (the dry run failed for a reason that is not a spec validation error); the message names them; rechecked on every Observe
reasons.action: Wait: it is rechecked on every pass. If it lasts, the message names the compositions that could not be checked.
